title: Changing Pair: The Half-Trillion-Step Mirror
question: What does reflection symmetry explain in a huge transfer-matrix path count?
method: 8-state column masks, transfer matrix under non-overlap adjacency and bit-order reflection; recovered original handoff.
finding: Reversal symmetry forces equality of the first-half factors in the two restricted counts; overall B and C values need not coincide.
claim_scope: Universal-in-L reflection invariant for this specified 8-state transfer matrix; reported modular counts at the stated L.
limitations: The second worker handoff, some labels, executable and historical run receipt were not recovered.
open_questions: What additional conclusions, if any, would the original missing evidence support?
